# Joseph Doyle-Samadi — Software Engineer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Joseph Doyle-Samadi, a software engineer building
> full-stack web applications. Contact: contact@josephsamadi.uk.
> GitHub: https://github.com/icarus2419 ·
> LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/josephsamadi/

Based in Streatham, London, Joseph builds reliable, interactive software with a focus on Python,
JavaScript/TypeScript, React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and WebSockets.

## Key facts

- Author and maintainer: Joseph Doyle-Samadi.
- Location: Streatham, London, United Kingdom.
- Education: BSc in Computer Science, University of Liverpool.
- Site purpose: software engineering portfolio and project case studies.
- Primary contact: contact@josephsamadi.uk.
- Main technologies shown: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, FastAPI,
  Redis, PostgreSQL, WebSockets, Swift, SwiftUI, AppKit, IOKit, Stripe, Supabase,
  Cloudflare Workers, Node.js, Express, HTML, CSS, Three.js, and Vercel.
- Last updated: October 2026.

## Projects

- [Knockround](https://josephsamadi.uk/project/knockround/): job planning, quotes, rounds and
  payments for UK tradespeople. Bills customers can pay by card, Apple Pay or
  Google Pay, and an offline mode for working with no signal. React and
  TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers (Hono, D1, R2) with Stripe Connect.
  Built with a business partner. Site: https://knockround.co.uk/. App: https://app.knockround.co.uk/.
- [SkillHanger](https://josephsamadi.uk/project/skillhanger/):
  Free, open-source native macOS app built with SwiftUI and AppKit for
  discovering and managing Codex and Claude Code skills and plugins,
  viewing usage limits, and monitoring tasks with optional idle-sleep protection.
  Source: https://github.com/icarus2419/SkillHanger.

- [Modular Multiplayer Poker Platform](https://josephsamadi.uk/project/poker-platform/):
  Python game engine with FastAPI-style routes, Redis-backed room state, and a
  polling-first browser client. Playable at https://josephsamadi.uk/poker/.
- [NoSite Leads](https://josephsamadi.uk/project/nosite-leads/):
  Full-stack SaaS that uses the official Google Places API to find businesses
  with no website listed, with private map-based results, CSV export, Stripe
  payments, and recoverable scan jobs on Cloudflare Workers.
